[[Oswestry]], [[Shropshire]], England | capacity = 3,000 (3,000 seated) | chairman = [[Mike Harris (entrepreneur)|Mike Harris]] | manager = [[Craig Harrison (footballer)|Craig Harrison]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Welsh football updater|TheNewS}} | season = {{Welsh football updater|TheNewS2}} | position = {{Welsh football updater|TheNewS3}} | website = {{URL|https://www.tnsfc.co.uk/|tnsfc.co.uk}} | pattern_la1 = _macronrhodiumeco23w | pattern_la2 = _macronelves25rbw | pattern_la3 = _macronwyverneco24ba | pattern_b1 = _tns2324h | pattern_b2 = _macronelves25rbw | pattern_b3 = _macronwyverneco24ba | pattern_ra1 = _macronrhodiumeco23w | pattern_ra2 = _macronelves25rbw | pattern_ra3 = _macronwyverneco24ba | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so1 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | leftarm2 = 0000FF | body1 = FFFFFF | body2 = 0000FF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = 0000FF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 0000FF | socks1 = FFFFFF | socks2 = 0000FF | shorts3 = 000000 | socks3 = 000000 }} '''The New Saints of Oswestry Town & Llansantffraid Football Club''', commonly known as '''The New Saints''' ({{langx|cy|Clwb Pêl-droed y Seintiau Newydd}}) or '''TNS FC''' are a [[Professional sport|professional]] [[Association football|football]] club that play in the {{Welsh football updater|TheNewS}}, part of the [[Welsh football league system|Welsh football system]], but are based completely within England, in [[Oswestry]], Shropshire. They are the most successful club in the Welsh league structure,{{cite news |last1=Wathan |first1=Chris |title=Dancing in the streets of TNS - Life with Wales' most successful club |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/crkdj2452gmo |access-date=2 March 2026 |work=BBC Sport |date=2 October 2024}} with 18 league titles to their name.{{cite web |title=The New Saints secure 18th JD Cymru Premier title with stoppage win over Connah's Quay Nomads |url=https://faw.cymru/cymru-leagues/news/the-new-saints-secure-18th-jd-cymru-premier-title-with-stoppage-win-over-connahs-quay-nomads/ |publisher=Football Association of Wales |access-date=9 March 2026 |date=3 March 2026}} Since the 2001–02 season, they have finished as champions or runners-up in every season, apart from [[2008–09 Welsh Premier League|2008–09]], when they finished third in the league. They became the first side playing in the Welsh league system to qualify for the group or league stage of any European competition after reaching the league phase of the [[UEFA Conference League]] for the first time in the [[2024–25 UEFA Conference League|2024–25 season]].{{cite web |url=https://www.tnsfc.co.uk/2024/08/30/the-new-saints-opponents-in-the-league-phase-of-the-2024-25-uefa-conference-league-confirmed/ |title=The New Saints' opponents in the league phase of the 2024/25 UEFA Conference League confirmed |publisher=The New Saints F.C. |date=30 August 2024 }}"}}
